title: Demodulating Soviet-French Venus balloon probe signal for JPL
summary: Bob Maguire tells of Demodulating Soviet-French Venus balloon probe signal for JPL, about mid-1980s at Venus; Institute for Defense Analysis; Jet Propulsion Laboratory, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Venus; Institute for Defense Analysis; Jet Propulsion Laboratory

tellings.quote: the Russians and the French sent a probe to Hal's Comet the Probe on its way did a gravitational assist fly by a Venus while it was near Venus it dropped two balloon probes into the atmosphere of Venus

plain: Bob Maguire, a former contractor who says he worked for the Institute for Defense Analysis, a US defense research group, tells of a job from the mid-1980s. He says a Soviet and French probe headed for Halley's Comet swung past Venus and dropped two balloon probes into its atmosphere, and that he helped decode their signal for the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, NASA's space probe centre. He tells it to show the kind of high-level technical work he was trusted with.
